description: This file defines the AppManagerImplementation class, which implements application management and configuration interfaces for a plugin system. It includes class definitions, enums, method declarations, and internal classes related to app lifecycle, package info, and notifications.

classes.name: AppManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing application management and configuration interfaces, handling app lifecycle, package info, notifications, and internal state management.

classes.name: PackageManagerNotification
classes.description: Notification class for package installation status updates.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Dispatchable job class for handling asynchronous events related to app management.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for app management events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: LaunchApp
methods.description: Launches an application given its ID, intent, and launch arguments.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Closes a specified application.

methods.name: TerminateApp
methods.description: Terminates a specified application.

methods.name: KillApp
methods.description: Kills a specified application.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves information about loaded applications.

methods.name: SendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent to a specified application.

methods.name: PreloadApp
methods.description: Preloads an application with given launch arguments.

methods.name: GetAppProperty
methods.description: Gets a property value of an application.

methods.name: SetAppProperty
methods.description: Sets a property value for an application.

methods.name: GetInstalledApps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of installed applications.

methods.name: IsInstalled
methods.description: Checks if an application is installed.

methods.name: StartSystemApp
methods.description: Starts a system application.

methods.name: StopSystemApp
methods.description: Stops a system application.

methods.name: ClearAppData
methods.description: Clears data for a specific application.

methods.name: ClearAllAppData
methods.description: Clears data for all applications.

methods.name: GetAppMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for an application.

methods.name: GetMaxRunningApps
methods.description: Gets maximum number of concurrently running apps.

methods.name: GetMaxHibernatedApps
methods.description: Gets maximum number of hibernated apps.

methods.name: GetMaxHibernatedFlashUsage
methods.description: Gets maximum flash usage for hibernated apps.

methods.name: GetMaxInactiveRamUsage
methods.description: Gets maximum inactive RAM usage.
